# CycleCase

`schemas/testing/cycle-case.json`

A case of the installed cycle harness (M1 slice plan §2.6, P24): fixtures/m1/cases/&lt;case&gt;/case.json, run by lib/adc/scripts/installed-cycle.sh. Its project is a T0 project (fixtures/t0/&lt;project&gt;), its task one of that project's tasks, whose committed hidden/ files are its acceptance; the stub provider serves its scenario (fixtures/m1/stub-provider/scenarios/&lt;scenario&gt;.json). control is the positive control proving the setup discriminates (§2.7). expect is what the run must show.
